title: Chicago Rescue
subtitle: February 14, 1929. Lovebirds in Chicago kissed each other as the bell tolled. Nobody noticed the gunshots.

items.text: Chicago Rescue

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I did not expect that there is such a big place in your suitcase. I never knew it before.
Not too late to know now.

branch.speaker: Sonetto
branch.text: You are right. I am very happy to be invited over.

items.text: Huh? You didn't call me "Timekeeper"?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I got promoted.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The committee recommended me ... to help you as the chief assistant.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The scope of your responsibilities has also increased. You will be in charge of all the investigations on the "Storm" and Manus Vindictae. The authorities will provide us with assistance in all aspects.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... So, you have seen what the "Storm" was like?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The outside world ... is very different from what I thought.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: As the Timekeeper, you've always carried such a secret for us. Thank you.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you for bringing the message, Sonetto.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So, what's the first mission for our team?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Please take a look.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: According to the latest historical intelligence, there will be a massacre against arcanists in Chicago on February 14.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We need to rescue the victims before human gangsters arrive at the underground parking.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Rescue the arcanists?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It doesn't conflict with the Foundation's purpose, right? Preventing confrontations between two races is also a way to defend the peace of mankind.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Although this is different from all the missions before.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The authorities would probably want us to recruit new arcanists for the Foundation as much as possible.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I see.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The forces of the Manus expand dramatically year by year. To stop the trend, we do need additional manpower.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But ... Sonetto, did you have oranges just now? There is a scent of orange on the capsule.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: How come? I did not. And ... I will definitely wash my hands after eating.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Maybe that's my mistake. If there is no question, we are ready to go ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Whoa! You guys, come here and help!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It is ... Regulus's voice? Why is her voice coming from above ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Whoa!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Our ... our suitcase is about to be moved by the critters!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Ms. Vertin! Sonetto!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Seems like our suitcase has disturbed some imps! Captain went out to check but got trapped!
Hurry up and help!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain, hang in there!
TO BE CONTINUED...
